label: Screen code for members only: what a signed-out visitor may download

params.name: on
params.label: on: a visitor who is not signed in gets only the public files (turn on only when app.js loads its screens after sign-in)

params.name: extra_public
params.label: this portal's own public files, beside chip static.public_files

params.name: member_cache
params.label: Cache-Control on a guarded file (and its 404): never kept by a shared cache

description_nl: 2026-10-16 (owner "yes hide", core/private_static.py): with on, every file under roots that is not public (chip static.public_files + extra_public) is served only to a signed-in member, marked member_cache and Vary: Cookie; a visitor gets the same 404 as a file that does not exist. Off in the framework: a portal turns it on in its own chips/static.signed_out.json once its app.js loads screens after sign-in (shell.js startPortal screens).
weight_basis: A security switch and cache header, no business content.
